entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Justice V. Narasingh

Order
Order No. 26.09.2025
01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No. 2723 of 2022 pending in the Court of the learned S.D.J.M., Berhampur arising out of Gopalpur P.S. Case No. 230 of 2022 for commission of offences punishable under Section 420/272/273/34 of IPC read with Section 20/24 of Cigarettes & Other Tobacco Products Act and Section 51 / 52 / 53 / 56 / 57 / 59 / 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

3. Admittedly the Petitioner was before this Court in ABLAPL No.14636 of 2022 as Petitioner No.2 and by order dated 19.12.2022 this Court granted liberty to the Petitioner to surrender and seek for bail.
4.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that since in the meanwhile charge sheet has been filed, the Petitioner may be protected by pre-arrest bail.
5. Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for pre-arrest bail.

6. Considering the nature of allegations, this Court finds force in the submission of the learned counsel for the State that the submission of the charge sheet in the interregnum only lends credence to the case of prosecution.
Hence, this Court is not inclined to entertain the ABLAPL.
However, it is directed that the Petitioner may surrender before the learned S.D.J.M., Berhampur in connection with the aforementioned case within one month from today.

In the event of his surrender and motion for bail, the same be considered by the learned S.D.J.M.,

sentences.text: In the event of rejection of the prayer for bail by the learned S.D.J.M., Berhampur, the Petitioner is at liberty to move the higher forum for bail in the second hour on the same day.
7. On being so moved, the higher forum is requested to make an endeavor to dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day.

The case diary be made available to the concerned courts to facilitate disposal of the bail application of the Petitioner and learned S.D.J.M., Berhampur is called upon to transmit the case record to the higher forum at the earliest in the event of rejection of such bail application.
Ground of parity, if any, may be considered by the learned court(s) below.
8. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
U.C.C. as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Ayesha Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Bipin Kumar Sahu vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 26 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/9656863/
